title: Tube Interchange
brief: a transit interchange where two elevated tube lines cross at different levels

footprint.note: line A (east-west) at level 1.2, line B (north-south) at level 3.4; both continue as network tiles

requires.note: joins tube network A on both sides
joins tube network B on both sides
concourse entrance on the south side

power.note: traction feed for both lines at the station + lifts

transit.note: any cell within 8 cells counts as served by lines A and B

light_air.note: two tubes over one lot shade the ground beneath

construction.name: piers
construction.action: cast four piers (two low for line A, two tall for line B) and the platform columns

construction.name: tube segments
construction.action: lift the line A station segment onto the low piers, then line B onto the tall piers

construction.name: platforms
construction.action: hang the two enclosed glass platforms alongside the tubes

construction.name: circulation
construction.action: raise the glazed lift tower on the north-east corner (platform B) and the stair + landing to platform A

construction.name: concourse
construction.action: set the ground concourse hall and signage; commission
